401918075.headline: The Citadel vs. Clemson prediction: model has Clemson by 13
paragraphs: The Citadel (3-1) visits Clemson at Littlejohn Coliseum in Clemson Monday at 7 PM ET on ACC Network.

Our model makes Clemson a 12.8-point favorite, projecting an 82-69 final, and gives Clemson a 86% chance to win. The betting market has Clemson favored by 24 with a total of 145. The model leans The Citadel +24.0 and Over 145.
Players to watch: Aaron Ekwere of The Citadel, 13.9 points a game; Chase Cormier of The Citadel, 8.1 points a game; Ramel Bethea of The Citadel, 4 points a game.
The Citadel is on one day of rest and is playing its second straight road game.
flavor: Author Pat Conroy played for The Citadel from 1963 to 1967 and chronicled the 1966-67 Bulldogs in My Losing Season; his No. 22 jersey was honored in 2018.
